content.json:
# Portfolio Operations & Observability

**Project 2 | Azure Cloud Operations & Observability Platform**

A live operational view of API health, portfolio usage, cost and Azure governance. Operations telemetry uses a rolling 4-day window. Portfolio and cost panels query their source systems when refreshed.

## 01  Application Operations & Monitoring

Application health · request traffic · failures · availability · exceptions

content.query:
union
(
    requests
    | where timestamp >= ago(4d)
    | summarize Value=count()
    | project Title="Total Requests", Metric=todouble(Value), SubTitle="Last 4 days"
),
(
    requests
    | where timestamp >= ago(4d)
    | summarize Value=countif(success == false)
    | project Title="Failed Requests", Metric=todouble(Value), SubTitle="Application Insights success = false"
),
(
    requests
    | where timestamp >= ago(4d)
    | summarize Total=count(), Failed=countif(success == false)
    | project Title="Failure Rate", Metric=iff(Total == 0, 0.0, round(100.0 * todouble(Failed) / todouble(Total), 2)), SubTitle="Percent"
),
(
    requests
    | where timestamp >= ago(4d)
    | summarize Value=countif(toint(resultCode) >= 500 and toint(resultCode) <= 599)
    | project Title="HTTP 5xx Errors", Metric=todouble(Value), SubTitle="HTTP 500-599"
),
(
    requests
    | where timestamp >= ago(4d)
    | summarize Total=count(), Errors=countif(toint(resultCode) >= 500 and toint(resultCode) <= 599)
    | project Title="HTTP 5xx Rate", Metric=iff(Total == 0, 0.0, round(100.0 * todouble(Errors) / todouble(Total), 2)), SubTitle="Percent"
),
(
    availabilityResults
    | where timestamp >= ago(4d)
    | summarize Total=count(), Passed=countif(success == true), Failed=countif(success == false), Unknown=countif(isnull(success))
    | project Title="Availability", Metric=iff(Passed + Failed == 0, 0.0, round(100.0 * todouble(Passed) / todouble(Passed + Failed), 2)), SubTitle=strcat(Passed, " passed / ", Failed, " failed / ", Unknown, " unknown")
)
content.title: API Health & Availability — Last 4 Days
content.noDataMessage: No data found for the selected period.

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp >= ago(4d)
| summarize Requests = count(), FailedRequests = countif(success == false), Http5xx = countif(toint(resultCode) between (500 .. 599)) by Operation = name
| extend FailureRatePct = iff(Requests == 0, 0.0, round(100.0 * todouble(FailedRequests) / todouble(Requests), 2))
| project Operation, Requests, FailedRequests, Http5xx, FailureRatePct
| order by Requests desc
| take 8
content.title: API Operation Health — Top Operations
content.noDataMessage: No data found for the selected period.

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp >= ago(4d)
| where success == false or toint(resultCode) between (500 .. 599)
| project Timestamp = timestamp, Operation = name, ResultCode = resultCode, Success = success, Url = url, OperationId = operation_Id
| order by Timestamp desc
| take 10
content.title: Recent API Failures — Last 4 Days
content.noDataMessage: No data found for the selected period.

content.query:
availabilityResults
| where timestamp >= ago(4d)
| project Timestamp=timestamp,
          Test=name,
          Location=location,
          Success=success,
          Message=message
| order by Timestamp desc
| take 30
content.title: Availability Test Results — Passed / Failed / Unknown
content.noDataMessage: No availability test records were returned in the last 4 days.

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp >= ago(4d)
| extend StatusCode=iff(isempty(resultCode), 'Unknown', tostring(toint(resultCode)))
| summarize Requests=count() by StatusCode
| order by toint(StatusCode) asc
content.title: HTTP Status Code Distribution — Last 4 Days
content.noDataMessage: No data found for the selected period.

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp >= ago(4d)
| summarize Requests = count(), FailedRequests = countif(success == false), Http5xx = countif(toint(resultCode) between (500 .. 599)) by bin(timestamp, 1h)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Request Volume & Failures — Hourly
content.noDataMessage: No data found for the selected period.

content.query:
exceptions
| where timestamp >= ago(4d)
| summarize ExceptionCount = count(), FirstSeen = min(timestamp), LastSeen = max(timestamp), SampleMessage = take_any(iff(isempty(outerMessage), innermostMessage, outerMessage)) by ExceptionType = type
| order by ExceptionCount desc
content.title: Exception Details — Last 4 Days
content.noDataMessage: No data found for the selected period.

content.query:
exceptions
| where timestamp >= ago(4d)
| extend Operation = iff(isempty(operation_Name), '(Unknown operation)', operation_Name)
| summarize ExceptionCount = count() by Operation
| top 10 by ExceptionCount desc
| order by ExceptionCount desc
content.title: Exceptions by API Operation — Last 4 Days
content.noDataMessage: No data found for the selected period.

content.query:
Resources
| where resourceGroup =~ 'rg-portfolio'
| where type in~ (
    'microsoft.insights/components',
    'microsoft.web/sites',
    'microsoft.documentdb/databaseaccounts',
    'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts',
    'microsoft.insights/scheduledqueryrules',
    'microsoft.insights/metricalerts',
    'microsoft.insights/webtests',
    'microsoft.consumption/budgets'
)
| extend HttpsOnly=tostring(properties.httpsOnly),
         MinimumTlsVersion=tostring(properties.siteConfig.minTlsVersion),
         PublicNetworkAccess=tostring(properties.publicNetworkAccess),
         IdentityType=tostring(identity.type),
         RetentionDays=tostring(properties.retentionInDays),
         Enabled=tostring(properties.enabled),
         BudgetAmount=tostring(properties.amount),
         BudgetTimeGrain=tostring(properties.timeGrain),
         BudgetStart=tostring(properties.timePeriod.startDate),
         BudgetEnd=tostring(properties.timePeriod.endDate)
| project Name=name, ResourceType=type, Location=location, HttpsOnly,
          MinimumTlsVersion, PublicNetworkAccess, IdentityType, RetentionDays,
          Enabled, BudgetAmount, BudgetTimeGrain, BudgetStart, BudgetEnd
| order by ResourceType asc, Name asc
content.title: Security, Governance, Retention & Budget Configuration
content.noDataMessage: No matching security, retention, budget or monitoring resources were returned.

content.query:
AuthorizationResources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.authorization/roleassignments'
| extend Scope=tostring(properties.scope),
         PrincipalId=tostring(properties.principalId),
         PrincipalType=tostring(properties.principalType),
         RoleDefinitionId=tostring(properties.roleDefinitionId)
| where Scope contains '/resourceGroups/rg-portfolio'
| project Scope, PrincipalId, PrincipalType, RoleDefinitionId
| order by Scope asc
content.title: RBAC Role Assignments — rg-portfolio
content.noDataMessage: No matching security, retention, budget or monitoring resources were returned.

content.json:
## 03  Azure Resource & Monitoring Inventory

Live Azure Resource Graph inventory and monitoring rule configuration.

content.query:
Resources
| where subscriptionId == '8bb846b6-1057-42bb-a02a-7a64e6a34178'
| where resourceGroup =~ 'rg-portfolio'
| project name, type, location, kind
| order by type asc
content.title: Azure Resource Inventory

content.query:
Resources
| where resourceGroup =~ 'rg-portfolio'
| where type in~ (
    'microsoft.insights/metricalerts',
    'microsoft.insights/scheduledqueryrules',
    'microsoft.insights/webtests',
    'microsoft.insights/actiongroups'
)
| extend Enabled=tostring(properties.enabled),
         Severity=tostring(properties.severity),
         EvaluationFrequency=tostring(properties.evaluationFrequency),
         WindowSize=tostring(properties.windowSize),
         MetricName=tostring(properties.criteria.allOf[0].metricName),
         Threshold=tostring(properties.criteria.allOf[0].threshold),
         ActionGroupCount=tostring(coalesce(array_length(properties.actions), array_length(properties.actions.actionGroups)))
| project Name=name, RuleType=type, Enabled, Severity, EvaluationFrequency,
          WindowSize, MetricName, Threshold, ActionGroupCount
| order by RuleType asc, Name asc
content.title: Alert Rules, Thresholds & Action Groups

content.query:
exceptions
| where timestamp >= ago(4d)
| summarize Exceptions = count() by bin(timestamp, 6h), type
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Exception Trend — 6-Hour Intervals
content.noDataMessage: No data found for the selected period.
